self_declared_provenance.quote: Originating in elasticity with Eshelby's celebrated discovery ... EIM replaces material heterogeneity by fictitious eigenfields on bounded supports ... The same closure principle extends well beyond linear elasticity

This paper adopts the same reuse principle for reaction-diffusion-advection (RDA) dynamics: once the screened Green's kernel is known, inclusion thresholds, interior amplification, and interaction laws follow from geometry-only Eshelby maps.
